messages:
alice: Heads-up 11 opening PR to add a short migration guide for the new pricing tier names + a small example for metering header enforcement. Will keep examples minimal for Quickstart.

priya: Nice 1 can you include both JS and curl snippets showing the recommended `X-Redwood-Metering-Id` header and the server-side fallback for legacy clients? We should show a deterministic example response for the dashboard.

alice: Yep. Draft JS snippet: 

```js
// recommended: include metering id to attribute usage
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-latency-2',
  input: 'Analyze logs',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Metering-Id': 'acct-9876' }
});
```

curl example:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Metering-Id: acct-9876" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-latency-2","input":"status report"}'
```

priya: That looks good. For the server fallback mention something like: `If header missing, clients should set the meter id via the client config or SDK helper to avoid attribution to 'unattributed' bucket.`

alice: Added that line. Also added a short CSV export example for teams who want to reconcile analytics with billing: `start,end,project,meter_id,token_count` and a one-row sample.

tom: Can you add a small JSON blob for the Console panel so product teams can copy it into our dashboard importer? Something like a minimal panel that shows `tokens_by_meter` timeseries with a `meter_id` legend. Keep it grayscale, minimal labels.

alice: Dropping a tiny panel JSON (note: simplified):

```json
{"type":"timeseries","metrics":[{"id":"tokens_by_meter","label":"Tokens (meter)"}],"legend":{"show":true,"fields":["meter_id"]}}
```

tom: Perfect. One UX nit: we renamed "Standard" to "Core" in the pricing UI. Make sure the migration guide shows the old->new mapping table. Customers will search for the old term.

alice: Added mapping table (old name -> new name) and a short note: "If you query via API, both names are accepted until 2026-08-01; after that only new names are valid."

docs-bot: CI started for PR #4183 1 lint, link-check, image-size.

alice: Link-check failed 1 inline dashboard image 404. Replaced image with `/assets/docs/tiny-panel-gray.png` and updated alt text.

docs-bot: Link-check: OK. Lint: OK. Image-size: OK.

infra-bot: Reminder: metering header enforcement rollout window is 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-22. Please include rollout note and a fallback window for SDKs.

alice: Added a Release Plan section with dates and an SDK compatibility note. Also added `i18n: short-copies requested` for localization.

qa-bot: QA ticket DOCS-2012 created and assigned to @qa-team. Please validate example outputs, CSV sample, and that the dashboard JSON imports without errors.

priya: Tiny wording tweak: change "unattributed" to `unattributed-legacy` to match Billing labels.

alice: Done and pushed. Squashed commits.

tom: Approved and re-ran local build. No layout regressions on the Quickstart panel.

docs-bot: PR #4183 merged into main by tom. Release note: "Add migration guide for pricing tier renames; small metering header examples, CSV reconciliation sample, and dashboard panel JSON."

alice: Thanks all! I'll follow up with a short changelog entry and ping support to watch for migration questions. :heart:

priya: Great work 1 closing the loop here.
